title: Sacred hadith
hookLine: words from Allah in the Prophet's phrasing, not part of the Qur'an
tomorrow: I am as My servant thinks

lines: NOT A VERSE OF THE QUR'AN.
cards: O My servants. A report in Sahih Muslim opens with those words, and the voice speaking isn't the Prophet's own.
The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ is relating what Allah said: O My servants, I have forbidden injustice for Myself and made it forbidden among you, so do not wrong one another. It isn't a verse of the Qur'an.
You won't find it in any surah. And yet the one speaking, in the first person, is Allah. So what kind of text is this?

teach.b: First, the name. Hadith, a report. Qudsi, holy.
So: a sacred report, one in which the Prophet relates words from Allah. Second, the layers.

teach.h: THE PROPHET SAID THAT ALLAH SAID.
teach.b: The Prophet said that Allah said. One voice carried inside another, like a letter read aloud by the person who received it. That's today's line: allah said, he said.
Third, how it differs from the Qur'an. Scholars explain it this way. The Qur'an is Allah's word in its meaning and its wording, recited in prayer, its very sound counted as revelation.

teach.h: MEANING FROM ALLAH, THE PROPHET'S WORDS.
teach.b: A hadith qudsi carries meaning from Allah, in the Prophet's own phrasing. It isn't recited as Qur'an in the prayer. And it's graded like any other hadith, by its chain, so some are sound and some are weak.
Everything from the last two weeks still applies. Fourth, the tone: it comes close. The report from Muslim keeps going.
O My servants, all of you are hungry except the one I feed, so ask Me for food and I will feed you. All of you are unclothed except the one I clothe, so ask Me for clothing.

teach.h: A NEEDLE DIPPED IN THE SEA.
teach.b: And near its end: if every one of you, first and last, asked, and each were given what they asked, it would take from what Allah has no more than a needle takes from the sea when it's dipped in and lifted out.
A voice that speaks of hunger, clothes, mistakes and asking. Not distant at all.

how: Muslims read hadith qudsi for reflection and teaching, and some books gather them in one place; they are not recited as Qur'an in the ritual prayer.

o: a verse of the Qur'an that is recited only at night
a saying from the Prophet's family about holy places
words from Allah, related by the Prophet in his own phrasing

p: the Prophet said that Allah said
a needle dipped in the sea
all that was asked, from all He has

s: a hadith qudsi is a verse of the Qur'an
it's a report outside the Qur'an, and it isn't recited as Qur'an in the prayer.
a hadith qudsi is graded by its chain, like any hadith
some are sound and some are weak; the chain still matters.
in the report from Muslim, Allah forbids injustice for Himself
I have forbidden injustice for Myself and made it forbidden among you.

games.q: you hear a saying in which Allah speaks in the first person, and someone says it's in the Qur'an. you search every surah and it isn't there. what is it most likely to be?
o: a hadith qudsi, a report the Prophet relates from Allah.
a mistake: Allah only speaks in the Qur'an.
games.why: a hadith qudsi. the Prophet relates words from Allah, outside the Qur'an. then you'd check its chain, like any hadith.

practice: Read it a line at a time, with a breath between each: I have forbidden injustice for Myself; and made it forbidden among you, so do not wrong one another; ask Me for food, and I will feed you; a needle, dipped in the sea.
Then think of someone you might wrong without meaning to, by a word, a delay, a shortcut, and just see their face. If you pray, you can carry the line about asking into your next prayer.

wordCard.voice: Hadith qudsi. A sacred report: words from Allah that the Prophet relates in his own phrasing, outside the Qur'an. Today's word.

orig.note: a sacred report: qudsi means holy, sacred.

carryVoice: Your line: allah said, he said. One voice carried inside another, like a letter read aloud. Until next time.
